name: search_products
description: Search the product catalogue by keyword and return a ranked list of matching products with their price and total units available across all variants. Use this when the customer describes what they want but has not named a specific product. Results are summaries only: call get_product_detail for variants and SKUs, which are what create_order requires.

query.description: Free-text keywords matched against product name, description and category.

category.description: Restrict results to one category. Omit to search all categories.

max_price.description: Exclude products priced above this amount, in USD.

in_stock_only.description: When true, exclude products with no units available in any variant.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

error_returns.when: query is empty, or category is not one of the listed values.
